solution:
names = ["一段故事", "一幅插画", "一首短诗", "一段视频"]
values = [4, 3, 5, 2]
threshold = 3

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
